themes_detail.label: Illegal Posting Surge
themes_detail.summary: Illegal posting complaints spiked to 6 THIS WEEK versus a baseline of 0.1 per week over the prior 8 weeks—a 4700% surge (z-score: 17.76)—suggesting a coordinated poster campaign or enforcement gap in Bed-Stuy that warrants immediate investigation.
evidence: 6 illegal posting complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Z-score of 17.76 indicates extreme statistical outlier
Represents the single largest proportional spike in all monitored complaint categories
reporting_angles: Physical canvassing of neighborhoods to photograph and map posting locations; interview residents on visibility and enforcement
DSNY records check: has enforcement staffing or priorities shifted? Are there known poster rings active in Brooklyn?

themes_detail.label: Homelessness & Encampments Explode
themes_detail.summary: Encampment complaints jumped to 32 THIS WEEK from a baseline of 2.1 per week over 8 weeks—a 1406% spike (z-score: 15.21)—indicating either a rapid influx of unsheltered populations or a newly visible clustering that demands urgent social services response.
evidence: 32 encampment complaints THIS WEEK vs. 2.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (1406% increase)
Z-score of 15.21 signals a crisis-level anomaly
Aligns with repeated budget requests from Community Board for 'other services for the homeless' (DHS), suggesting chronic under-resourcing
reporting_angles: Ground reporting: map the encampments by location, interview residents and unhoused individuals on triggers (shelter capacity, weather, displacement?)
Policy angle: DHS response timelines; is the city's shelter system at capacity? Cross-check with DHS intake data and shelter census this week

themes_detail.label: Animal Welfare Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Animal abuse complaints surged to 9 THIS WEEK from a baseline of 3.6 per week over 8 weeks—a 148% spike (z-score: 4.41)—paired with unleashed dog complaints up 336% two weeks ago, suggesting an emerging animal control or community responsibility gap.
evidence: 9 animal abuse complaints THIS WEEK vs. 3.6 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (148% increase, z-score: 4.41)
6 unleashed dog complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 1.4 weekly average (336% increase, z-score: 3.8)
Two separate spikes suggest systemic breakdown in animal control enforcement or owner compliance
reporting_angles: Interview NYPD Animal Care and Control on complaint response times and resource allocation to Bed-Stuy
Resident interviews: are there specific locations or individuals responsible? Are there awareness gaps on leash laws?

themes_detail.label: Elevator Safety Deteriorating
themes_detail.summary: Elevator complaints jumped to 16 LAST WEEK from a baseline of 6.0 per week over 8 weeks—a 167% spike (z-score: 4.59)—raising questions about aging building stock maintenance and DOB inspection frequency in a district with significant residential density.
evidence: 16 elevator complaints LAST WEEK vs. 6.0 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (167% increase, z-score: 4.59)
482 alteration permits filed in past 90 days, suggesting active building work that may strain aging systems
No recent DOB data available on elevator inspection frequency or violations by building
reporting_angles: DOB FOIL request: elevator violations and inspection records for Bed-Stuy buildings; has inspection cadence kept pace with building age?
Building owner interviews: are elevators undergoing deferred maintenance? Are there cost-sharing disputes among residents?

themes_detail.label: Street Safety Concerns Spiking
themes_detail.summary: Safety complaints (broad category) surged to 19 two weeks ago from a baseline of 6.1 per week—a 210% spike (z-score: 4.52)—alongside elevated bike/roller/skate and unleashed dog complaints, indicating possible public space disorder or enforcement inconsistency.
evidence: 19 safety complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 6.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (210% increase, z-score: 4.52)
3 bike/roller/skate complaints last week vs. 0.2 weekly average (1100% increase, z-score: 6.35)
6 unleashed dog complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 1.4 weekly average (336% increase, z-score: 3.8)
reporting_angles: Interview NYPD community affairs on precinct enforcement priorities; has visibility/policing of parks and streets shifted?
Resident focus groups: what specific safety incidents or public space concerns prompted the surge in complaints?
